svg.title: AKILI-SPECS methodology lifecycle
svg.desc: AKILI-SPECS lifecycle: /akili-constitution sets the baseline once; each spec then runs /akili-propose, /akili-specify, /akili-execute, /akili-test, /akili-validate and /akili-archive, and a Kaizen retrospective feeds the next spec. A spec whose deliverable is a video adds Video Mode, render evidence and a final-look review; diagram slots are filled at constitution, specify and archive. Anytime commands: /akili-resume, /akili-audit, /akili-quick, /akili-seo and /akili-security, whose confirmed findings enter the Bug Track through /akili-propose.
